mainEntity.name: What is website optimization for GEO targeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Website optimization for GEO targeting is the process of improving your website's visibility and relevance to users in specific geographic locations. This involves adjusting content, technical SEO elements, and local citations to rank higher in local search results. The goal is to attract more local customers by ensuring your website appears when people search for your services or products within a defined area, such as New York City or Los Angeles.
